title: Spatial Molecular Signatures of Canine Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma with and Without Locoregional Metastasis with Cross-Species Comparison to Human Samples.
snippet: Accurate diagnosis of locoregional spread in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is critical for prognosis and treatment planning. However, the currently available pre-surgical staging modalities often fail to detect occult nodal metastasis, necessitating nodal extirpation for accurate pathologic staging. This approach carries no clinical benefit....
